# bugfix

Use project configuration and relevant risk controls. This fallback contains baseline controls only; task packets add controls from prompt risks and changed file paths.

1. Reproduce expected versus actual behavior and identify root cause.
2. Add a regression test; verify it fails because of the defect.
3. Apply a focused fix; verify the regression passes and relevant existing tests pass.

For each step: establish inputs, act within scope, check the result, record evidence. If prerequisites fail, stop dependent steps and report the blocker.

Baseline controls: CTRL-004.1, CTRL-004.2, CTRL-004.4, CTRL-005.1, CTRL-005.5, CTRL-006.6, CTRL-011.1, CTRL-014.1, CTRL-014.2, CTRL-014.5, CTRL-015.4, CTRL-017.1, CTRL-017.2.
- CTRL-004.1: Run configured lint and formatting checks on changes.
- CTRL-004.2: Apply configured function length and complexity thresholds; prefer small focused functions.
